## One batch of transactions

Called by the review, never by the agent. It asks Claude about a handful of
transactions at a time and then checks the answer against what was actually
offered.

The guard after the model is the part that matters: an account code or tax
type that is not in this organisation's own lists is emptied rather than
corrected, and the row is handed to a person. A plausible wrong code is the
failure nobody notices until an accountant does.
